description: This file defines the SugarMin class, which provides functionality for minifying JavaScript source code. It includes a static method for minification and internally uses the JShrink Minifier library. The class encapsulates the process of parsing and minifying JavaScript through multiple passes, handling comments and whitespace removal.

classes.description: A class responsible for minifying JavaScript code using multiple passes, leveraging the JShrink library.
